description: Bootstrap Next.js 14 project with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma, and NextAuth.js. Remove all existing files and create a fresh project structure with all dependencies configured.
steps: Remove all existing files in /projects/sandbox/notherobrinesmplol/ (index.js, package.json, package-lock.json, Procfile, config.json) but preserve .git/ and .agents/ directories

Create a new Next.js 14 project manually (no create-next-app to avoid interactive prompts) with the following files: package.json with all dependencies (next, react, react-dom, typescript, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, prisma, @prisma/client, next-auth, @next-auth/prisma-adapter, bcryptjs, @types/bcryptjs, zod), tsconfig.json, next.config.js, tailwind.config.ts, postcss.config.js

Create the app/ directory structure: app/layout.tsx (root layout with dark mode support, Inter font, metadata for SmoothOpsX), app/globals.css (Tailwind directives plus custom CSS variables for theming)

Create prisma/schema.prisma with models for: User (id, name, email, password, emailVerified, image, businessType, techStack as String[], regions as String[], alertFrequency, severityLevels as String[], createdAt, updatedAt), Account (NextAuth), Session (NextAuth), VerificationToken (NextAuth), Regulation (id, name, shortName, category, severity, region, affectedArea, summary, fullDescription, whatChanged, deadline, publishedAt, createdAt, updatedAt), ActionItem (id, regulationId, title, description, priority, techStackRelevance as String[], createdAt), UserActionItem (id, userId, actionItemId, status enum TODO/IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED, completedAt, createdAt, updatedAt)
Create lib/prisma.ts with singleton PrismaClient pattern for Next.js
Create lib/auth.ts with NextAuth configuration using CredentialsProvider (email/password) with Prisma adapter, JWT strategy, custom pages for signin/signup
Create app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts that exports the NextAuth handler
Create .env.example with DATABASE_URL, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, NEXTAUTH_URL placeholders
Run npm install to install all dependencies
Run npx prisma generate to generate Prisma client (will work without a real DB connection)
Verify the project compiles with npx tsc --noEmit
acceptance_criteria: All old project files are removed
package.json contains all required dependencies for Next.js 14, Tailwind, Prisma, NextAuth
TypeScript compilation passes with npx tsc --noEmit
prisma/schema.prisma contains all required models with proper relations
Tailwind CSS is configured with dark mode support
NextAuth is configured with credentials provider
verification: npx tsc --noEmit passes without type errors
npm run build succeeds (Next.js production build)
findings: Added types/next-auth.d.ts to extend NextAuth Session and JWT types with user id field. This is needed for the session callback in lib/auth.ts. Build and tsc --noEmit both pass cleanly. .env file with dummy values needed for build (prisma generate requires DATABASE_URL).
